      Assumptions, provenance & lesson source
      The paths are deterministic native exports, not empirical forecasts or optimal policies. Authored coefficients are game assumptions, not estimated Federal Reserve behavior. The reference is the first listed option, not a recommendation. Only the provided eight quarters are shown.
      Inflation, unemployment and output gap are displayed in percent; their differences are percentage points. Credibility is a 0–1 index, displayed multiplied by 100. Public support is already a 0–100 index, displayed without rescaling. Both use /100 labels and differences in index points. Assets, loans and uncovered funding are % initial GDP; their differences are percentage points of initial GDP. Absent optional ledger values are “Unavailable,” never zero.
